items.claim: Film and drop retention is calibrated on one measured condensation plate (acrylic, 54 g/m2) and one modelled rain plate (PVC, 0.08 mm, the upper reading), and transferred to each finish through Furmidge with assumed hysteresis.
items.needed_to_ground: Weigh a full-scale curved panel with each finish after rain and dew at 0-90 deg and inverted.

items.claim: 040's white silicate paint has no sourced wettability or water uptake; it is modelled as a hydrophilic oxide.
items.needed_to_ground: Contact angles and uptake of the actual paint.

items.claim: P3's ponds use 024's sag crown and mean, 052's bay size through its sag debit, a quadratic dish and a planar bay pattern near the top. 052 does not fix the frame's orientation; the pond mass spans 5-171 kg at R 10 with it.
items.needed_to_ground: A full-size sagged bay with members: pond mass against tilt, and the spill angle.

items.claim: P3's OD4/white protection outer layer has no sourced wettability; paint-like and FEP-like bounds are used.
items.needed_to_ground: Contact angles of the actual protection layer.

items.claim: Drying is bracketed between 040's sphere correlation and a flat-plate wind correlation (a factor up to about 8); the inner face is taken as adiabatic; the low solar absorptance of the mirror finishes limits solar drying.
items.needed_to_ground: An outdoor drying run on a finished panel under logged sun, wind, temperature and humidity.

items.claim: Dew is distributed by this seat's energy balance (050's saturated case within 2%, reference 25% low); frost and freezing of retained water are not modelled (no verified frost source).
items.needed_to_ground: Night dew and frost weighing on a finished panel.

items.claim: The superhydrophobic topcoat's dry areal mass assumes 1.0-1.5 g/cm3 on its 13-25 um film; it is 'hazy translucent white' and unqualified over a silver mirror; it lasts about a year and 30 Taber cycles.
items.needed_to_ground: Areal mass, optics and life of the coating on the finish.

items.claim: Shelter cost scales one 30 x 15 m inflatable hangar price by floor area; height, wind and handling are not addressed; historic airship hangars are not comparable.
items.needed_to_ground: A quotation for a shelter sized to the hull.

items.claim: Air-knife residual water and a gantry for a sphere are not sourced or costed.
items.needed_to_ground: A blow-off test on a curved panel.

items.claim: Tipping a moored P3 sphere past 14 deg needs handling hardware that is not designed.
Rain met in flight adds water beyond the ground-retained film; not computed.
Retained water changes the finishes' absorptance and emittance (048's open item); dry optics are used.
items.needed_to_ground: Wet optical measurements on each finish.
